source_policy: Longest shared complete-day segment chosen solely by previously audited quality; no repairs, imputation or source replacement.
cost_policy: Each side charges half nominal roundtrip bps on actual modeled notional, including fee plus assumed spread/slippage; reserve in fixed signal-close quantity.
touch_policy: No protective price orders at source defaults; both registered gap models are intentionally identical, one history. Retain fail-closed history gates and no ambiguity pruning.
entry_policy: floor8(cash*0.1/(signal_close*(1+sidecost))); fixed before next-open execution, all-or-reject; native opening-equity quantity parity NOT claimed; no resizing, borrowing, pyramiding or orders
clock_policy: Completed8h geometry and own position-dependent profit exit decide next1m-open. Original short takes exit reason priority if both predicates true. Existing position counts held long flags before liquidation; no same-boundary re-entry. Entry reference raw fill-bar open becomes usable at fill-bar close. No protective orders, invented timeout or intrabar re-entry.
endpoint_policy: Completed events use modeled exit reference; still-held events retain statusCENSORED_MTM and cutoff close mark with hypothetical liquidation burden, never a fictitious order or completed trade.
principal_return_estimand: All admitted entry-to-exit-or-fixed-cutoff net reference returns; completed-only means separately descriptive. Per-unit return=(exit/entry)*(1-sidecost)/(1+sidecost)-1.
funded_btc_benchmark: At each accepted alt entry allocate the same alt notional/preentry-cash fraction from a separate BTC cash account. Exact BTC open entry; open exit uses BTCopen, intraminute exit uses BTCminute low/high bounds; own costs and remaining inventory; cutoff uses known final close.
portfolio_policy: Equal three independent1000USDT cash sleeves; shared8h close mark and hypothetical sale burden. Funded BTC cash/reference uses identical timing. This smaller10% intent is source-derived; existing drawdown30% gate is unchanged.
bootstrap_policy: Moving contiguous4calendar-week blocks incl zero-event weeks; retain fixed alpha0.025,97.5% two-sided intervals from prior comparator. One newly registered cell; conservative fixed carryover, not two cells or global repeated-search inference.
placebo_policy: 500 randomized raw long entry flags within eligible calendar entry weeks preserving count. Rerun own entries, raw fill-open reference, dynamic profit exits, durations and original short-to-cash geometry; never reuse observed exit flags or holding lengths. Max control versus minimum observed mean, descriptive only.
lag_policy: Shift raw long entry flags7bars after zeroing pre-warmup flags; same dynamic own-position exit engine; descriptive.
diagnostics: fixed UTC sessions and overlap memberships
funded BTC wealth and same-exit reference bounds
claim: Spent historical hypothetical development only; SCREEN_SURVIVOR permits separate future preregistration, never viable/untouched/positive-edge/deployment claim.
future_confirmation: User completion requires a separate immutable and adequately powered future-only protocol, calibrated costs/quotes/execution, controls and approval-bound paper reliability, frozen before observations start. No viable candidate until that confirmation passes.
dependency_hash_policy: Python dependency bytes normalize CRLF to LF solely for cross-platform checkout; all data/audit fingerprints remain exact bytes
family_disclosure: Distinct small directional candle-shadow geometry with EMA level filter, not EMA crossover or a new independent EMA-edge claim. Initial narrower source survey exclusion is retained and corrected by later default-intent audits before this freeze. Source-disabled protection is not enabled to improve results.

full_candle.shadow: range=high-low; shadow=high-close if close>open else close-low; percentage=(shadow*100)/range; zero-range remains NaN
full_candle.ema: first-valid-close seed; alpha=2/(10+1); beta=1-alpha; EMA=alpha*close+beta*previousEMA; separate binary64 operations
full_candle.long_profit_exit: close>(raw_fill_bar_open + raw_fill_bar_open*0.002) and close>open; exact multiply then add, strict comparison
full_candle.capture: On each accepted long, reference is raw 8h fill-bar OPEN. It is usable only at that fill-bar CLOSE, then persists until replaced by next accepted long.
full_candle.short_adapter: Original qualifying short closes an existing long to cash; no shorts opened
full_candle.source_close_call: Close(Long) while flat does not cancel pending Long entry. Held same-side entry ignored even when same decision closes old Long; no same-boundary re-entry.
full_candle.disabled_price_orders: Declared mathematical port treats disabled TP/SL as absent price orders; native all-NaN strategy.exit runtime is unverified
full_candle.timeframe: Source specifies no timeframe; user-selected8h adaptation
full_candle.quantity: floor8(cash*0.1/(signal_close*(1+sidecost))); fixed before next-open execution, all-or-reject; native opening-equity quantity parity NOT claimed
full_candle.quote_currency: Source1000USD adapted to1000USDT with explicit1:1 research accounting assumption; no conversion/native parity claim
